paper_title: An analysis of vaccine-related sentiments from development to deployment   of COVID-19 vaccines
caption: : Caption not extracted
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the distribution of counts of vaccine-related sentiments, categorized by their polarity scores, ranging from -1.0 to 0.6. The x-axis, labeled “Polarity scores,” uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, spanning from -1.0 to 0.6. The y-axis, labeled “Counts,” uses a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 10,000, ranging from 0 to 50,000. A single blue line with circular markers connects data points across the polarity spectrum. The line remains near zero counts from -1.0 to approximately -0.6, then rises steadily to a peak of 50,000 counts at a polarity score of 0.0. Following this peak, the line drops to approximately 18,000 counts at a polarity score of 0.1, rises again to approximately 28,000 counts at 0.2, then declines to approximately 10,000 at 0.3, dips to zero at 0.4, rises to approximately 10,000 at 0.5, and finally falls to zero at 0.6.
